scope: Linux CPU-only, pristine frozen upstream SDK. Measurement only: no production change, no merge, no release.
supersedes: The '1 < ratio < 2 is untested' gap and the ratio-1.0 boundary wording of docs/RCA159_THREAD_OVERSUBSCRIPTION.md as of commit 5233a9e. Rates and groupings are re-derived from these sweeps; the older coarse-grid cells stay in the record and are not silently dropped.

sweeps: ci/rca159_ratio_sweep.sh (one-step CPU walk at fixed cap)
ci/rca159_interleaved.sh (all arms per round, drift control)
method.note: One decode call per fresh process: no state from a previous frame can be involved. Decodes report OKAY (code 0) even when the frame digest differs.

summary.modal_frame_sha256_domain: Every modal_frame_sha256 value in this file, including per-cell copies, is sha256 of the image region (pitch*height = 8294400 bytes, 1920x1080, pitch 7680) PLUS 64 sentinel bytes 0xCD (8294464 bytes total). The probe hashes out.data()/out.size() after prefilling that tail; retained BGRA dumps contain only the 8294400 image bytes. Recomputed 2026-10-23 with sha256sum on retained Linux outputs from 2026-10-18. Exemplars of the modal class: rca159-mech/p39/dec_c00.bgra and harness dumps/p1/dec_c00.bgra. 214 of 243 exact-size retained BGRA files share this pair; the rest are non-modal frames.
